title: Araujo addresses possibility of joining Liverpool permanently from Barcelona: ‘I’m very happy here’
tweet: Araujo says it’s too early to talk about a permanent move, but his focus stays on improving. As things stand, Liverpool’s €55 million purchase clause keeps the option alive, yet nothing is confirmed.

title: Dani Olmo’s case to start vs PSG: Why Barcelona need him more than Fermin Lopez
tweet: Olmo’s tendency to drop into midfield gives Barça a temporary three‑man passing triangle against PSG’s rotating trio, a set‑up that López’s high‑running style cannot match; however, López’s late runs could still be decisive later in the match. The choice hinges on the opponent’s press, not on hierarchy. Whether Flick starts Olmo ahead of López remains to be seen.

title: Three talking points ahead of PSG vs Barcelona | UEFA Champions League
tweet: Barça enter the UCL group‑stage clash with PSG as the only unbeaten side in Europe, but a defensive wobble after Betis leaves Kounde, Garcia and Martin in doubt; Flick will need to decide on a full‑back pairing and whether the recovered Raphinha is match‑fit. The Parisians, two‑time Champions League winners, will aim to test Barça’s high line and could swing momentum if Barça’s attack falters. As things stand, the game is a prestige duel; the outcome will either break Barça’s pointless record or reinforce the need for a deeper defensive squad.
